races.paceDynamic: Pioneer Pete will set an honest but sustainable tempo with minimal early pressure, creating excellent conditions for hold-up horses. Seven horses want prominent positions (Double Tiger, Prince Of Clova, Emerald Time, Chico Magnifica, Hashtag Queen, Collanisi, Asta La Vista, Hellion) which will create dangerous traffic problems turning for home and at the crucial 2-3 hurdles out.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pioneer Pete Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Pioneer Pete gets an uncontested lead and maintains his strong recent form.
scenarios.body: The leader dictates fractions perfectly while the prominent pack gets tangled up behind. His superior course experience and current confidence carries him clear from the last hurdle.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion creates the expected traffic chaos turning for home.
scenarios.body: The seven prominent runners interfere with each other's progress while the hold-up brigade find clear runs down the outside. Our Guide and Finbarr benefit most from the strong early pace and clean late passages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Breaks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners avoids the traffic and gets first run on Pioneer Pete.
scenarios.body: Double Tiger or Chico Magnifica position perfectly to strike approaching two out before the hold-up horses can organize their challenges. The winner comes from those tracking the leader closest without getting caught in the squeeze.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Pioneer Pete stops quickly and the prominent pack fails to capitalize.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with no clear leader after the second last hurdle. Any horse finding daylight can win in a bunched finish where ratings matter less than position and jumping.

watchPoints.text: Seven horses wanting prominent positions behind Pioneer Pete will create severe traffic problems from two furlongs out
Millford Hill historically fades in the finish so any early market support should be questioned
Pioneer Pete's jumping confidence has improved markedly since his recent Cheltenham win
Our Guide needs this race to unfold with interference up front to maximize his hold-up style
Double Tiger's recent course experience could prove crucial if he avoids the prominent pack squeeze

races.paceDynamic: Holeshot is the only confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable gallop without early pressure. With Giovanni Change, Mixedwave, The Clonmel Kid, and The Great Escape all prominent runners, they'll track Holeshot in the early stages before the hold-up horses Cardamon Hill, Youdecide, Slaney Opera, and Ithaka make their moves from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Holeshot gets soft fractions and stays strong over 3m
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows Holeshot to dictate terms and kick clear when the field closes. His stamina reserves prove decisive as challengers arrive too late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses apply enough pressure to soften up Holeshot
scenarios.body: Giovanni Change or Mixedwave travel strongly behind the leader before striking in the straight. Their tactical position and class ratings give them the edge over tiring leaders and late closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Horse Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Cardamon Hill or Ithaka benefit from their patient tactics as the race becomes tactical. Their finishing kicks from the rear prove superior when the early leaders stop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Staying Power Test
scenarios.trigger: If the genuine pace stretches the field and it becomes a true stamina test
scenarios.body: The 3m trip and testing conditions find out the non-stayers among the prominent runners. Slaney Opera's proven stamina at longer trips gives him the edge in a grueling finish.

watchPoints.text: Holeshot's jumping under pressure - if he makes mistakes when challenged his chance disappears quickly
Giovanni Change's early positioning - needs to be handy but not too keen to preserve his finishing kick
Cardamon Hill's progress through the field - must be making smooth headway by 2 out to feature
The pace through the middle section - if it quickens notably it will set up the hold-up horses perfectly
Mixedwave's traveling - when prominent runners travel easily it usually spells trouble for the leader

races.paceDynamic: King Of The Road and Ionian will likely dispute the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners creating an honest tempo from the start. The large field contains several prominent racers (Freshers Week, No Ordinary Joe, Dirty Den) who will track the leaders closely, while the significant hold-up brigade (Bras d'Or, Miss Cynthia, Dunkerque) will need the pace to collapse to be effective. This setup favors those who can sit handy and quicken rather than pure front-runners or back-markers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If King Of The Road and Ionian maintain a strong gallop without one capitulating early
scenarios.body: The honest tempo stretches the field and favors those racing prominently who can sustain their effort. Hold-up horses struggle to make up ground as the pace doesn't collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front-runners (King Of The Road/Ionian) drops away early leaving a tactical affair
scenarios.body: The reduced tempo creates a stop-start race that suits hold-up performers with a strong finish. Late runners get their ideal scenario with plenty left to aim at.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Fierce Early Duel
scenarios.trigger: If King Of The Road and Ionian engage in a prolonged speed battle through the early stages
scenarios.body: Both front-runners weaken dramatically in the final half-mile, creating opportunities for midfield runners. The pace meltdown allows closers to sweep up but favors those not too far back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Muddle
scenarios.trigger: If neither front-runner shows their usual early speed creating an unusually slow early pace
scenarios.body: The lack of pace creates a messy, stop-start affair where positioning becomes crucial. Those able to adapt tactically and quicken from any position hold advantages.

watchPoints.text: King Of The Road and Ionian's early battle intensity will determine whether hold-up horses get their preferred pace collapse
No Ordinary Joe's prominent position early will indicate whether his recent struggles continue or class tells
Miss Cynthia's positioning turning for home reveals if the pace has set up for her customary late charge
Freshers Week's ability to maintain position when pace quickens will show if consistency can translate to victory
Bras d'Or's progress from two furlongs out indicates whether the tactical setup has favored late runners sufficiently

races.paceDynamic: Parramount will set the pace from the front with minimal pressure from the other prominent racers early on. The lack of confirmed early speed means a steady, sustainable gallop that should suit the closers, particularly Singapore Trip who can use his hold-up style to maximum advantage. This moderate pace setup favors horses that can quicken late rather than those needing to make their effort from distance.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Favors Closer
scenarios.trigger: If Parramount maintains an even tempo throughout without significant pressure from the prominent brigade
scenarios.body: Singapore Trip gets the perfect setup to unleash his finishing kick in the final two furlongs. The moderate pace allows him to overcome his low rating through tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Duo Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Koapey and Gaelic Rambler press Parramount earlier than expected, creating genuine pace pressure
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and favors the two highest-rated horses with proven stamina reserves. Koapey's superior recent form gives him the edge in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Parramount gets left alone on the lead and the field allows him too much rope
scenarios.body: He builds an unassailable advantage through the middle stages and has enough left to resist late challenges. His front-running style proves optimal when not pressured early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Scrappy Pace Suits
scenarios.trigger: If the race develops into a stop-start affair with multiple horses vying for position early
scenarios.body: Zero Tolerance benefits from the tactical nature, using his prominent style to stay handy before finding extra in the closing stages. His lack of recent wins becomes irrelevant in a muddling contest.

races.paceDynamic: Thank You Ma'am will lead uncontested from the start, setting a measured gallop that will suit her stamina over this 3-mile trip. With three prominent runners (American Mike, Escapologist, Jalisco Star) likely to track her but no other confirmed leaders, the pace will be honest but not frantic. This setup strongly favors the hold-up horses Kent De Thaix, Jupiter Des Mottes and Ballygeary who can capitalize on a strong finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Thank You Ma'am sets steady fractions and the prominent runners don't apply serious pressure
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow for the leaders to sustain their kick, allowing the back-markers to unleash devastating finishing runs. Kent De Thaix and Jupiter Des Mottes storm home with superior class telling over the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Thank You Ma'am gets soft sectionals and maintains her jumping rhythm throughout
scenarios.body: She builds an unassailable lead turning for home while the hold-up horses find too much to do. Thank You Ma'am's stamina reserves prove decisive as she holds off late challengers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If American Mike or Escapologist apply pressure from the 3rd last hurdle
scenarios.body: The increased pace suits their running style perfectly while compromising both the leader and hold-up horses. American Mike's class advantage becomes telling as he times his challenge to perfection.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Thank You Ma'am goes too slow early and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: A messy sprint finish develops where jumping becomes crucial and any horse can win. Jalisco Star's recent hurdles win gives him the confidence edge in a blanket finish.

races.paceDynamic: Jonquilla and Steady The Ship will contest the early lead, with Jonquilla likely to dictate given her stronger recent form and higher rating. The large field contains predominantly hold-up horses, creating a scenario where the pace-setters may get an easy time in front before facing a wall of finishers. This tactical setup favors either a bold front-running performance or the strongest closer who can time their run perfectly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Jonquilla and Steady The Ship get soft fractions and jump cleanly throughout
scenarios.body: The early pace will be steady rather than fierce, allowing the leaders to conserve energy for a strong finish. Hold-up horses will struggle to peg back the advantage built by horses who've had first run on every obstacle.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Perfect Closer Timing
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine but not excessive, setting up ideal conditions for hold-up horses
scenarios.body: The front pair will weaken in the final half-mile as the ground and distance take their toll. A strong closer with proven stamina will sweep past tired leaders in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If jumping errors or the pace takes its toll on the leaders before the home turn
scenarios.body: Jonquilla or Steady The Ship will falter dramatically, leaving the race wide open for prominent racers to inherit. The tactical runners will benefit from the collapse without having to make up significant ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Staying Test Grind
scenarios.trigger: If the good going rides slower than expected and becomes a true stamina examination
scenarios.body: The 3-mile trip will become the decisive factor as shorter-distance specialists fade from contention. Horses with proven form over extended trips will gradually grind their way to the front in the final furlong.

races.paceDynamic: Middlecliffe looks the most committed early leader with several prominent runners (Cape Warrior, Noble Way, Cricket Hill Denis) likely to track close behind, creating a solid but uncontested pace. The lack of pure speed horses means this will develop into a tactical affair where positioning and stamina become crucial, particularly suiting hold-up performer Matador St Georges who can exploit any pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Holds
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners maintain a genuine pace throughout without significant slowdown
scenarios.body: The even pace favors those who can sustain their effort rather than needing a sprint finish. Cape Warrior and Middlecliffe benefit from their ability to travel strongly in the lead group.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes pedestrian mid-race before quickening significantly in the final 3f
scenarios.body: The tactical nature allows hold-up horses to get into contention before the pace lifts. Matador St Georges profits from his proven finishing kick while A Sight To Sea could emerge from obscurity.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Running Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Middlecliffe gets an uncontested lead and the field allows too much rope
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to dictate completely and prove hard to peg back. Middlecliffe builds an unassailable advantage while Cape Warrior provides the main threat from the chasing pack.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners go too fast early and come back to the field dramatically
scenarios.body: The overexertion of the pace-setters opens the door for outsiders with fresh legs. Cricket Hill Denis and A Sight To Sea benefit from others' mistakes despite their lower ratings.
